prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1064; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented for evaluation following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision. On initial examination, there was tenderness, swelling, and limited range of motion of the left wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a nondisplaced fracture of the distal radius. A volar splint was applied, and the patient was instructed on elevation, ice application, and use of over-the-counter analgesics.

Over the course of five visits, the fracture was monitored with serial clinical examinations and follow-up imaging, which confirmed stable alignment and progressive healing. The splint was maintained for the initial period and then transitioned to a removable wrist brace. Gentle active range-of-motion exercises were introduced, and the patient was progressed to grip strengthening as tolerated. Pain and swelling decreased steadily throughout the course of care.

At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated near-full wrist motion with mild residual stiffness and grip strength approaching the contralateral side. No neurovascular deficits were noted. The patient is expected to return to normal daily activities and work duties with continued home exercises and activity modification. Follow-up will be arranged as needed, with return precautions reviewed.
